items.note: N1 states the copy/gather/scatter/side-injection network, the three-stage exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restoration of arbitrary scratch, and its method follows the eight-row schedule. The cancellation is only described as 'intersection-size coefficients so that the unwanted ones cancel': the coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, the neighbour rules, the triple indexing and the wire counts are missing.

N2 states D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, and that only endpoint frames matter. The method is the paper's invariant: stored array = frame of logical array, and a common frame commutes with the pointwise gate.

The plan states nested nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, the only decreasing edges (central 3->4, loss h) and L_b/N=100/539, L_c/N=101/539 < 1/2. It never states the budget sum |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L or L=Ich, nor that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal. The telescoping count (sources N, sinks Wm-N) and the binary orthonormal bases are also missing from the derivation.

Projections P_U, the source matrices -P_{U_a}, the endpoint identity I_m, the deficit N-2L_b (equivalent to s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b) and the shear H<-H+D on every role are all present. The derivation omits why N extra source ranks appear: the first edge on X_a is 2P_{U_a}, of rank one where the dimension change is zero.

The kernel-per-orthonormal-residual-vector statement, s_c<W_c m, telescoping to C^{⊗m} and the C=iZC^{-1}Z fix for the 27k inverse factors are correct. The frame is given only as the phase i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}, without the H^{⊗m} conjugation, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c is not stated. The step that turns the character into the translation X_v by Hadamard conjugation is missing.

The chain L/N<1/2 -> deficit N-2L>0 -> s<Wm -> deficits >20·2^{-50} -> s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} is present. The explicit η values and the step log m<20 that turns the deficit bound into m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-η) are missing.

Splitting, merging, digit moves, row splitting and the controlled shift by cut-and-remerge follow the paper. The statement drops the requirement that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time, and the derivation omits the absorption b^C=O(Q) that makes the offset work linear, as well as negation for signed units.

A=E_1ΠE_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry elimination, the four triangular transforms around ΠD, and one interchange per pivot all match the paper. The statement omits the fixed odd prime q chosen to avoid the denominators and diagonal numerators of the factors.

The plan has the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Φ_{A_e} on each edge by recursive interchanges, the three updates D<-D-H, H<-H+D, D<-H-D, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric sum giving O(e^τ), and the O(V) parking-stack schedule. This is the paper's proof.

The top ρ digits become a row field of range ≥W^k, rows are padded to a multiple of W^k, the remaining width is decomposed in base m with a geometric sum, and binary ranges are padded to [q^e]. This matches the proof.

The plan has conjugation by P_M, slots of f chunks, row additions by Gaussian elimination, s_c forward children of size e/m, inverse children through C^{-1}=-iZCZ, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D, which is the paper's route. The L1 wording 'each of the s_c residual-basis slots' is loose: there are m slots, and s_c is the total over the network.

The eight rotations as two 3-cycles, one cyclic shift per line, the guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11], the bad fraction 80(f-1)2^{-K}, bijections agreeing off B, radix-sort repair and the top-position XOR all follow the proof. The time is given only as O(V(L^τ+1)) 'plus negligible repair terms', without the explicit MA^3 and δ_bad MA(R+A) terms or the family hypotheses that make them negligible.

The node overhead O(V((eK)^τ+1)), the rows from q_0 chunks padded to W^{k_0}, the split u=Wg+w and F(e)≤(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) are present. The leaf cutoff e<d^β with F(e)=O(e) and the leaf contribution O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}) are missing, and so is the condition λ'>σ+β(1-σ). L2.3 claims the recurrence sums to O(e^λ).

The plan has O(Vd^{λ'}), exact evaluation with a single truncation of error <√2·2^{-p}, guard bits Δ=⌈C_0 d^{C_1}⌉ from A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E, εC_1<1 giving Δ=o(p), and the proof's reduction to s_c children of volume 1/W_c.

Character cancellation by the shift t/2^{v+1}, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the layout L by prefix moves and chunk exchanges, the cost and the error √2ℓ2^{-p} all match. The H3 method misdescribes which slots go to the prefix (listed as an error); H3.2 states it correctly.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, centred residues with |h_j|<B_0/2, negacyclic reduction and the O(rp log(rp)) cost are as in the paper.
Retained LB order, the commuting of pointwise products with the same record permutation, the exact scaling by M=T/r, the error 3δ+η before scaling and the cost all match the proof.

P_sF_s=2^{2α^2}B_0P_tF_tA with contractions, error <p^2, time O(tp^{3/2+δ}α), the tensor form and the axis-exposure cost are stated, and the derivation follows the S,T,C,D and Neumann-series route. The permutations (P_s u)_j=u_{tj}, (P_t v)_k=v_{-sk} and γ=2dα^2 are never defined.
The chirp a_j, QF_t u = ā·(a*(ā·u))/T, the identity RF_s^+R=F_s^+ obtained by substituting h=ck, and the factor S^{-2} are all as in the paper's proof.

The exponents, sizes, T∈[4n/b,8n/b), α, the prime intervals, Bernoulli's inequality giving T/2<S<T, and the trial-division search are present. η=1/(4d) is never given a value, and the conclusion α^4θ_i>p is only paraphrased as 'separation needed by Gaussian resampling'.
Φ:x->∏x_i^{μ_i} with μ_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, the isomorphism, the triangular prefix-controlled shifts (described in words) and the O(Tpd^2(1+ℓ^τ)) cost follow the paper.

The plan has x_d->ζy with (ζy)^r=1, the diagonal invertibility, the wrap check ζ^{k+l}(-1)^h=ζ^j, and the computed twist-convolve-untwist with twist errors 2·2^{-p}. The M_C formula is given in words only.

The source transform (A, chirp, B_0, scale 2^γ) with exact counterpart RF_s, the opposite transform by conjugation, and the six-step algorithm with the two occurrences of S explained all match the paper.

Contraction and bilinear error propagation, E_s=9·2^γTL, G(U·V_1)=(u*v)/S^2 with error (3E_s+2), the final error <448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2 and the carry invariant all match. E_w<28·2^γT^2L is not shown explicitly.

Costs normalized by Tp, seven margins with the smallest g_2=2^{-181}=2κ, log factors absorbed by p^κ, and a schoolbook cutoff. The seven table entries are not listed individually, but they appear in H3, I2 and K4.
Only the name 'nlogn-conjecture' appears among R's relies-on. No step states what an eventual lower bound means or why one machine with O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}) refutes it.

errors.says: Method: 'Move the top slots of each axis to a prefix'.
errors.paper: The prefix list is the top slot (i,ℓ-1) of the long axes only, followed by the low slots (i,h) for h=b-1,...,0 of every axis, so that what remains of each axis is q consecutive K-bit chunks.

errors.says: With a=s/W<m^λ the recurrence F(e)≤(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^τ+1) sums to O(e^λ).
errors.paper: Only the internal costs sum to O(e^λ). The leaves (e<d^β, F=O(e)) add O(e^σ d^{β(1-σ)}), which is why λ'>max{λ, σ+β(1-σ)} is needed.

errors.says: Apply the f-fold forward child on each of the s_c residual-basis slots.
errors.paper: A group has m slots; for each edge, one child is applied on slot h for each h ≤ ρ_edge. Summed over the network this gives s_c child calls, not s_c slots.

errors.says: A controlled update y->y+a(controls) mod Q costs O(V), with no condition on the offset.
errors.paper: The update costs O(V) only if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time; that work is absorbed because b^C=O(Q).

errors.says: Phase frames are i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}.
errors.paper: The frame is C_U=H^{⊗m} diag_x(i^{q_U(x)}) H^{⊗m}. The phase is diagonal in the Hadamard basis, and this conjugation is what turns characters into translations X_v.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: two networks with s<Wm give the interchange (C1) and the butterfly layer (L), which feed the synthetic transforms and convolution (H); resampling and the chirp (G3), the algorithm (A), exact recovery (E) and cost accounting (K) close it. It thins out in the network budget, where the identity sum|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L, the rank-one source edges and the step log m<20 are missing. The layer recurrence also drops its leaf term.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and the restoration of scratch are fully stated. h=100, the indexing of the banks by triples, N=C(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent; m appears only as the dimension of F^{⊗3}. Rated conservatively as mentioned.
A common frame commutes with the pointwise gate, the array network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs D_v D_u^{-1}.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h.

N4's method makes edge differences residual projections whose rank is the dimension change. N3.2 refers to 'the extra source ranks', and the deficit N-2L_b in N4.1 encodes them, but the rank-one 2P_{U_a} source edges are never made explicit.
s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b follows only implicitly from the deficit N-2L_b. The budget sum|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L, L=Ich, and the telescoping from source sum N and sink sum Wm-N are absent.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0 is positive, and s<Wm.
M_sink(ρ(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, with P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m for X_a, giving H<-H+D on every row.
A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k≤(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} from deficits >20·2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^τ) are present. The auxiliary bound log m<20 is not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs most of the chain behind the saving: frames, labels, rank equals dimension change, the ratio L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. It is thin at both ends of the network construction. The concrete sizes h=100, N and m=h^3 are missing, and the budget identity sum|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, which turns L<N/2 into s<Wm, is only implicit in the stated deficit.
